_doc: Zulu Assistant publish manifest. Every git-tracked file must match exactly one list: `public` files are copied verbatim into the public checkout (core is identical in both repos by construction); `private` files never leave this repo. `node scripts/publish.mjs --check` fails on any unclassified or double-classified file, so a new file cannot slip out (or be forgotten) silently. Patterns: exact path, `dir/**` (everything below), or a single `*` wildcard within one path segment. Public-only files (README, LICENSE, docs/, the public CI and .gitignore, packaging) live under `publicRoot` and are published at their path relative to it; they may shadow a private file (this repo's README.md, .gitignore, ci.yml) but never a public one.
